'''Rass Ordo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of [[Clan Ordo]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. He was the brother of [[Jekiah Ordo]] and [[Layla Ordo]].

==Biography==
[[File:Rass_Ordo_on_Ruhnuk.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Rass Ordo on Ruhnuk]]
In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref> [[Mandalore the Avenger]] ordered Rass to accompany the [[Alliance Commander]] aboard the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'' in order to stop an attack by [[Clan Varad]], the [[Dar'manda]], and the [[Ash'ad]].<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

After Rass and the Commander fought their way to the bridge of the ''Spirit of Vengeance II'', they found [[Heta Kol]], who they engaged in combat. Upon her defeat, Kol called a retreat, but only after learning that her followers had captured the banner of [[Clan Cadera]].<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rass Ordo is a character from ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', voiced by [[Noshir Dalal]].<ref>''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' {{c|credits}}</ref> He first appeared in the flashpoint, "The Spirit of Vengeance", as a temporary companion for the player character. During the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|Legacy of the Sith]]'' expansion, he can be flirted with at several points by players of either [[Gender/Legends|sex]], which can potentially culminate in him calling the player "''cyar'ika''", the ''[[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]]'' word for "beloved", and giving them a kiss on the cheek during the expansion's finale, ''Legacy Reborn''.<ref name="Catchup">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Catching Up with Rass Ordo|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref><ref name="Legacy Reborn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Legacy Reborn|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref>
